name: charge-review
title: Monthly charge review
subtitle: Consumption and agreed rates. Amounts exclude tax.

sections.title: Charges by account and meter
sections.sql: select account,meter,month,currency,units,charge_cents from monthly_charges order by month desc,account,meter

sections.title: Usage without rates
sections.sql: select account,meter,month,units from monthly_charges where rate_id is null order by account,meter

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from attention_board order by due_on,account

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by account,rule

sections.title: Prepared statements
sections.sql: select account,month,currency,total_cents,status,reviewed_by from statement_register order by month desc,account
